title: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945 - Rule 158-B Licensing Requirements for ASU Drugs
content: Rule 158-B of the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 outlines the mandatory licensing requirements and proof of safety and effectiveness for manufacturing Ayurveda, Siddha, and Unani (ASU) drugs for sale. For Classical / Generic Formulations listed in authoritative texts specified in the First Schedule, proof of effectiveness is not required provided the formulation strictly adheres to classical text compositions and pharmacopoeial standards. For Patent or Proprietary Medicines containing ingredients specified in classical texts, safety data, textual rationale, and pilot clinical trial proof of efficacy are required as specified by the Licensing Authority according to the product category. Applications for obtaining or renewing a manufacturing licence must be submitted in Form 24-D to the State Licensing Authority along with statutory application fees, Schedule T Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) compliance proof, factory layout approval, competent technical personnel qualification details, and product testing records.
